verses.diwanu-wasa-ili-l-mutaqabbalati-fi-madhi: khalīlayyā ʿūjā bil-muḥaṣṣabi wānzilā walā tabghiyā ʿan khayfihi mutaḥḥawalā

nabiyyu lahu ʾaʿlā l-jināni mubawwaʾu
nabiyyu ʿaẓīmu l-qadri bil-ḥaqqi mursalu yuʿʿalu bihi mudh kāna ṭiflā wayunhalu
fallāhi minhu wahwa ʾaʿlā waʾakmalu ʾamīnu liʾirshādi l-ʿibādi muʾahalu
ḥabību biʾasrāri l-qulūbi munabbaʾu

fayā ḥabbadhā minhu liman shāʾa ʿumdata ʾimāmu lirusli llāhi badʾa waʿawdata
bihi yukhtamu dh-dhikru l-jamīlu wayubdaʾu
lahu rutbahu fawqa s-simākayni qad samat wakaffu nadā taḥkī s-saḥāba matā hamat
wāʾāyū hudā bil-ʾamri wan-nahyī ʾuḥkimat ʾidhā ʿuddidat lir-rusli ʾāyu taqaddamat
fāʾāyū rasūli llāhi ʾajlā waʾaḍwaʾu
ʾalaysa lladhī ḥāza l-mafākhira wal-ʿulā bimā naṣṣa min ʾāyī l-kitābi wamā talā
waʾannā yudānā fī l-makāni lladhī ʿtalā ʾatammu l-warā jāhā waʾabharuhum ḥulā
lahu l-madḥu yujlā wash-shafāʿatu tukhbaʾu
ḥawā kulla majdi lil-warā wajalālati wajāʾa bīʾāyāti maḥat kulla qālati
faman shakka fīhi fahwa ḥilfu ḍalālati ʾafī l-ḥaqqi shakku baʿda ʾalfi dilālati
taqaddamahā dhikru madā d-dahri yuqraʾu
litakhṣīṣihi fawqa l-khuṣūṣi maziyyatu thanathu ʾilayhā qismahu ʾazaliyyatu
makānatuhu fī l-mursalīna ʿaliyyatu ʾināratuhu ḥissā waʿaqlā jaliyyatu
falā l-wahmu yastawlī walā sh-shakku yaṭraʾu
fakam fāsidi ʾaḍḥā bihi wahwa ṣāliḥu wakam bāṭili wallā bihi wahwa ṭāʾiḥu
rasūlu liʾasrīri l-munāfiqi fāḍiḥu ʾabāna l-hudā fal-ḥaqqu ʾablaju wāḍiḥu
waṣāna l-warā fal-ʿayshu ḥulwu muhannaʾu
banā qubbaha l-ʾislāmi taẓharu khamsuhā faʾashraqa badru ṣ-ṣāliḥāti washamsuhā
waʾidh kāna mawḍūʿā ʿalā l-birri ʾussuhā ʾaṭāʿathu jinnu l-ʾarḍi ṭawʿā waʾinsuhā
wafuḍḍila bis-sabqi l-farīqu l-mubaddaʾu
ʾūlū l-birri wat-taqwā waʾahlu l-faḍāʾili ʿiṣābatu ʾishfāqi wakhayri wanīʾāʾili
samat biqubūli l-ḥaqqi min khayri qāʾili ʾaqarrat līʾāyāti lahu wadalāʾili
bihā ṣ-ṣubḥu ṭalqu waṭ-ṭarīqu muwaṭṭaʾu
ʾuḥibbu n-nabiyyā l-hāshmiyyā muḥammadā ʾajalla l-warā dhātā waʾaṣlā wamaḥtidā
waʾaṭyabahum nafsā waʾaṭwalahum yadā ʾaṭāba lahu r-raḥmanu nashʾā wamawlidā
famā zāla mimman khālafa l-ḥaqqa yabraʾu
ʿalā kulli fanni faḍḍala llāhu fannahu biʾan faraḍa d-dīna l-qawīma wasannahu
faqad sāsa ʾinsa l-khalqi ṭurrā wajinnahu ʾaʿid naẓarā fī l-khalqi taʿlam biʾannahu
kaʾaḥmada lam yunshaʾa walā huwa yunshaʾu
jazāʾu muṭīʿīhi ḥarīru wajannatu fadaʿ qawla kuffāri ʾaṣābathu jinnatu
famā huwa ʾillā min jahhanama junnatu ʾaghātha bihi llāhu l-warā fahwa muznatu
turawwī ṣ-ṣadā ʾaw ẓullahu tutafayyaʾu
ʾalam tara ʾanna llāha ʾāwāhu ʾidh ʾawā bighāri ḥirāʾi lil-māʾāli lladhī nawā
falammā ʾudīla l-qurbu min waḥshati n-nawā ʾafaqnā bihi min ghamrati l-ghayyī wal-hawā
falā ṭ-ṭibbu maʿdūmu walā n-nujḥu murjaʾu
nabiyyū l-hudā baḥru n-nadā ṣārimu l-ʿidā mubīduhumu bis-sayfi ʾidh ʾabawū l-hudā
waẓannū bijahli ʾannahum turikū sudā ʾatā wal-warā ʾasrā ḍ-ḍalālāti war-radā
faʾanqadhahum nūru yadullu wayaklaʾu
maḥūṭu biḥifẓi llāhi fī kulli hayʾati fafī ḥāli ʾīlādi wafī ḥāli nashʾahi
falammā ntahā baʾasā ʾumidda bijurʾahi ʾadhalla riqāba l-mushrikīna biwaṭʾahi
ḍulūʿuhumu min dhuʿrihā laysa tahdaʾu
huwa l-muṣṭafā l-maḥbūbu ṭabʿā waqurbaha taqaddasa dhātā thumma qabrā waturbaha
ʾaqūlu waʾaʿnīhi hawā wamaḥabbaha ʾuḥibbu rasūla llāhi shawqā waḥisbaha
laʿallī ghadā ʿan ḥawḍihi lā ʾuḥallaʾu
malāʾikahu r-raḥmani qālat bifaḍlihi waḥannat kamā ḥanna l-muḥibbu liwaṣlihi
ḥarāmu ʿalā l-ʾayyāmi ʾījādu mithlihi ʾuḥinnu ʾilā taqbīli mawṭiʾi naʿlihi
laʿalliyā ʾarwā billadhī kuntu ʾaẓmaʾu
ʾafī r-rusli man bil-hāshimiyyī yushabbahu ḥarāmu ʿalayhi n-nāru qalbu ʾaḥabbahu
rasūlu karīmu mā ʿaṣā qaṭṭu rabbahu ʾaʿadda laʾahwāli l-qiyāmati ḥubbahu
waḥasbī falī minhu malādhu wamaljaʾu
ʿasā waṭanu yadnū bihi walaʿallamā waʾillā falā ʾanfakku dahriyā mughramā
ḥalīfa ʾasā qad khālaṭa llaḥma wad-dimā ʾuʿallilu nafsī bil-wiṣāli warubbamā
tashakkā l-fatā ʾadwāʾahu wahyā tabraʾu
ṣabawta ʾilā d-dunyā wadhū llubbi lā yaṣbū wagharraka minhā s-salmu bāṭinuhā ḥarbu
fadharhā washarriq lā yaqirra bika l-gharbu biyathriba nūru lin-nubuwwati lā yakhbū
tashāraka fī ʾidrākihi ṭ-ṭarfu wal-qalbu
bihi fāstanir ʾin tantahiḍ bika himmahu walā tantaqiḍ min dūnihi laka ʿazmahu
fakullu ḍiyāʾi dūnahu fahwa duhmahu badā wabiqāʿu l-ʾarḍi ẓulmu waẓulmahu
faʾashraqati l-ʾarjāʾu wānqashaʿa l-karbu
ʾalahfī liʿumri fī l-maḥāli ʾaḍaʿtuhu samiʿtu bihi ʾamra l-hawā waʾaṭaʿtuhu
kaʾanniyā lam ʾaʿrif nabiyyā ʿaraftuhu bikulli kitābi lin-nabiyyīna naʿtuhu
waqad marra mā qāla n-nabiyyūna wal-kutbu
nabiyyu bighayri l-waḥyī lā yataṣarrafu ʿafuwwu ʿani l-jānī waqad yatawaqqafu
yalīnu biʾidhni llāhi ḥīnā wayaʿnifu bashīru nadhīru mūtharu mutaʿʿaṭifu
lahu d-dīmatu l-haṭlāʾu wal-ʿaṭanu r-raḥbu
faʾathni ʿalayhi bis-sakhāʾi wabīlḥayā wabīlṣṣabri yawma l-baʾasi ʾin kunta muthniyā
biḥḥaqi waqul fīhi walā takhsha munḥiyā badhūlu falā jadbu ʾidhā bakhila l-ḥayā
malādhu falā khawfu ʾidhā ṣammama l-ʿaḍabu
lahu l-qadamu l-maʿlūmu fī l-baʾasi wan-nadā faqad wahaba l-ʾaʿlāqa wāṣṭalama l-ʿidā
wafī kulli khayri jumlaha balagha l-madā bawāṭinuhu nūru ẓawāhiruhu hudā
falā hadyuhu yakhfā walā nūruhu yakhbū
lahu khuluqu ʿadhbu wabirru wawuṣlahu waṣabru ʿalā jahli l-jahūli wamuhlahu
wawajhu kamā lāḥat mina l-badri jumlahu bahhiyu mahību lam tuʿāyinhu muqlahu
mina n-nāsi ʾillā shaffahā r-ruʿbu wal-ḥubbu
ʾalā ʾinna mawlāhu ʾarāda ṣṭināʿahu faḥḥasana minhu khulqahu waṭibāʿahu
faʾaẓhara minhu dīnahu waʾashāʿahu balīghu ʾidhā staʿṣā llisānu ʾaṭāʿahu
lisānu biqawli l-ḥaqqi munṭaliqu raṭbu
lahu fī qtiyādi l-khalqi bil-ḥaqqi manzaʿu wathabtu liʾamri llāhi lil-khalqi ʾajmaʿu
wafī kulli khaṭbi dāʾuhu yutawaqqaʿu bayānu lahu fī n-nafʿi waḍ-ḍurri mawqiʿu
ʿalayhi tuḥḥalu s-salmu ʾaw tuʿqadu l-ḥarbu
ʾanāfa biwaḥyī llāhi ʾayyā ʾināfati ʿalā kulli dhī zajri wakulli ʿiyāfati
wakayfa yujārā bīkhtirāʿi khurāfati barīʾu bishaqqi ṣ-ṣadri min kulli ʾāfati
falā lamamu yuʿzā ʾilayhi walā dhanbu
laʾashraqati d-dunyā binūri bayānihi ʾalahfī ʿalā mā fātanī min ʿiyānihi
yuḥḥadithu minhu ʿan ʿulūmi janānihi baṣīru bisirri l-ghaybi qabla kiyānihi
lahu yaqrubu l-marmā watartafiʿu l-ḥujbu
faʾaʿẓim birifdi minhu qad ṣāba ʿurfuhu waʾakrim bidhikri minhu qad ṭāba ʿarfuhu
baṣīratuhu fī l-ʾamri yushkilu ṣarfuhu baṣīratu maʿṣūmi ʾidhā nāma ṭarfuhu
fal-qalbi ṭarfu lā yanāmu lahu hudbu
ʿalā ʾaḥmadi min rabbihi ṣalawātuhu laqad ʿaẓumat fī khalqihi barakātuhu
laqad baharat shamsa ḍ-ḍuḥā muʿjizātuhu barāhīnuhu lā tanqaḍī wahibātuhu
fāʾāyātuhu shuhbu waʾanmuluhu suḥbu
walammā jtabāhu rabbuhu lil-makārimi fahānat ladayhi ʾummahātu l-ʿaẓāʾimi
wamā ʾakhadhathu fīhi lawmatu lāʾimi banā qubbaha l-ʾislāmi fawqa daʿāʾimi
mina l-khamsi fī ʾafyāʾihā l-ʿujmu wal-ʿurbu
banāhā faḥāṭa l-ʿayna minhā maʿa l-ḥimā karīmu l-masāʿī lā yusāmā ʾidhā ntamā
khalāʾiquhu ʾandā mina l-ghaythi ʾidh hamā bwāriquhu tahdī l-qulūba mina l-ʿamā
falā ʿillahu tukhshā waqad ʾanjaḥa ṭ-ṭibbu
ʾatubṣiru ʾam ghaṭṭā baṣīrataka l-qadhā sajāyā rasūli llāhi ʾaḥmada fawqa dhā
ʾidhā shīʾa minhu l-khayru lam yanʾa ʿan ʾidhā badīʿu s-sajāyā fahwa badhlu walā ʾadhā
wamannu walā mannu waṣafḥu walā ʿatbu
muḥammadu l-ʾahdā maqālā waḥujjaha mubīnu l-hudā lis-sālikīna maḥajjaha
waʾaṣdaqu man yamshī ʿalā l-ʾarḍi lahjaha bihi khutima s-silku n-nabīʾiyyū bahjaha
lahu l-qurbu min dūni l-warā walahu l-ḥubbu
wahal baʿda masrāhu limawlāhu ghāyatu huwa l-ʿabdu ḥaqqā qarrabathu ʿināyatu

humu sh-shahbu ḥusnā ḥawlahu wahwa l-quṭbu
ʾuḥibbu rasūla llāhi ḥubba muwaḥiddi waʾamdaḥuhu bil-ḥaqqi ghayra mufannadi
waʾin balagha l-maṭlūba bil-madḥi mujtadi balaghnā bimadḥi l-hāshimiyyī muḥammadi
dhurā qunani mā ʾin tuṭāwiluhā l-huḍbu
laqad fāza man labbā waṭāfa wazārahu wamarragha fī dhāka t-turābi ʿidhārahu
yaqūlu waqad ʾadnā l-hawā minhu dārahu biḥḥubi rasūli llāhi narjū jiwārahu
wakullu muḥibbi fal-ḥabību lahu ḥasbu
madīḥu nabiyyī llāhi ʾazkā t-taʿʿabudi limā ḥāza min faḍli wafakhri wasuʾudadi
ʾamaʿshara man yudlī lahu bitawaddudi taʿālā faʿindī lin-nabiyyī muḥammadi
midīḥu kaʾazhāri l-khamāʾili ṭullati
madīḥu ʿalā l-ʾishābi lam yaqḍi ḥaqqahu ṣaḥīḥu l-maʿānī yaʿlamu llāhu ṣidqahu
waʾanna siwā l-mukhtāri lam yastaḥḥiqahu taballaja ʾiṣbāḥu l-ḥaqāʾiqi fawqahu
wafāḥa ʿalā faḥwāhu misku l-ʾadillahi
ḥulā l-muṣṭafā ʾakrim bihi ʾafḍalu l-ḥulā yuqaṣṣiru fīhā l-qawlu minnā waʾin ghalā
huwa l-ʾākhiru l-maʿdūdu fī l-faḍli ʾawwalā tabāraka rabbu kammala l-majda wal-ʿulā
liʾafḍali mabʿūthi biʾafḍali millahi
khiṣālu t-tuqā wal-birri minhu tuʿʿulimat washirʿatuhu ʾaḥyat sharāʾiʿa quddimat
banāhā wakānat qad ʿafat watahhadamat tamāmu niẓāmi lin-nabiyyīna tummimat
bīʾāyātihi ʾāyātuhum fāstaqallati
tahhadā bitawfīqi l-ʾilahi lidīnihi walā waḥyā ʾillā min ṣafāʾi yaqīnihi
walammā ʾatāhu rabbuhu biʾamīnihi talaʾalaʾa barqu l-bishri fawqa jabīnihi
wasaḥḥa ghamāmu r-rāḥati l-mustahhilahi
tayamman bihi wānwi t-tabarruka bīsmihi walā taʿdu fī shayʾi ṭarīqata rasmihi
faqad qasama l-mawlā lahu khayra qasmihi taraqqā ʾilā s-sabʿi ṭ-ṭibāqi bijismihi
waqad ʾashraqat ʾamlākuhā watajallati
taraqqā ʾilayhā ʾidh tamakkana ṭībuhu wakāda lahību sh-shawqi wajdā yudhībuhu
fajāʾa bihi naḥwa l-ʿilāji ṭabībuhu taraqqiyā maḥbūbi daʿāhu ḥabībuhu
faṭārat bihi ʾashwāquhu wataʿʿalati
takannafahu ḥifẓu l-ʾilahi waṣawnuhu wataʾayīduhu fī kulli ḥāli waʿawnuhu
wamimmā bihi qad khaṣṣahu llāhu kawnuhu tanāmu ʿuyūnu l-ghāfilīna waʿaynuhu
bimā shāhadat fī laylihā qad takhallati
takhallat liʾamri lam yunawwalhu man maḍā rāʾāhu lahu rabbu l-bariyyati murtaḍā
waḥīna nqaḍā min dhalika l-ʾamri mā nqaḍā talaqqathu ʾamlāku l-muhaymini bir-riḍā
waqad rafaʿat min shaʾanihi waʾajallati
ʾaḍāʾat sanāhu fāstabānat sanāʾahu wallāhi dānat fī ṣ-ṣalāti warāʾahu
walammā ʾaṭāba llāhu minhā thanāʾahu tamannat ʿalā karri l-ʿuṣūri liqāʾahu
falammā raʾathu qaddamathu waṣallati
laqad majjadat minhu ʾabarra mumajjadi ʿalā kulli mā yuḥẓā ladā r-rabbi munjidi
falā qadra ʾillā dūna qadri muḥammadi taḍāʾalati l-ʾaqdāru ʿan qadri sayyadi
shafā kulla qalbi min ḍanā kulli ʿillahi
huwa l-khayru d-dāʿī ʾilā khayri millahi karīmu jalīlu min kirāmi wajillahi
ḥawā l-fakhra min wajhayni waṣli wakhullahi taḥḥalat bihi l-ʾayyāmu ʾaḥsana ḥilyati
waḥallat bihi l-ʾafhāmu ʾaḥṣana ḥillahi
laqad fāza man kāna r-rasūlu ʾimāmahu yaqūdu bihi naḥwa n-najāti zimāmahu
wakullu mani staʿṣā ʿalayhi ʾanāmahu tasīru riyāḥu n-naṣri shahrā ʾamāmahu
faʾaʿdāʾuhu mā bayna khawfi wadhillahi
hadā ʾanfusā ḍallat ʿani r-rushdi fihtadat faṣāmat waqāmat laylahā watahhajadat
biyumni rasūli fī ṣ-ṣalāḥi bihi htadat taqallada sayfā lir-risālati ʾughmidat
lihaybatihi l-ʾasyāfu min ḥaythu sullati
taʿʿazaza daynā fāʿtalā kulla qimmahi wajarrada fī ʾaʿdāʾihi sayfa niqmahi
walammā ʿalā qadrā warifʿaha himmahi tadāʿat lahu l-ʾamlāku min kulli ʾummahi
ghurūrā falammā staqbalathu tawallati
banā likharābi sh-shirki ʾarfaʿa masjidi takhallafahu fī l-ʾarḍi ʾafḍala maʿhadi
fallāhi mā ʾaḥlā maqālata munshidi tazayyanati d-dunyā binūri muḥammadi
faḥḥalat bihi fī maʾamani wataḥḥalati
tabāraka rabbu khaṣṣa bil-faḍli ʿabdahu waṣāna ʿani d-dunyā d-daniyyati qaṣdahu
waṣayyarahu kaymā yukhallida majdahu talūdhu bihi l-ʾabṣāru fī l-ḥashri waḥdahu
wayuʿrafu qadru sh-shamsi bayna l-ʾahillahi
ʾatāḥa liʾidhhābi l-manākiri ʿurfahu waʿawwaḍanā ʿan wākifi l-qaṭri kaffahu
wajāʾa bihi fī l-ḥashri yaqdumu ʾilfahu tarāhu ʾimāmā wan-nabiyyūna khalfahu
waqad nushirat ʾaʿlāmuhu waʾaẓallati
laqad ʾaʿjaza l-ʾābāʾa ʾīlādu shibhihi nafā dāʿiyā d-dunyā bishiddati najhihi
waʾidh radda minhā ṭ-ṭawʿa ṣādiqu krhihi taqaddama wal-bushrā talūḥu biwajhihi
taqadduma makhṣūṣi biḥḥubi wakhullahi
ʿakafnā ʿalā ʾamdāḥihi nastaṭībuhā fanahtazzu kal-ʾaghṣāni māsa raṭībuhā
naqūlu waqad ṭālat waqāma khaṭībuhā taṭāwalati l-ʾamdāḥu wāzdāda ṭībuhā
walaw ʾannahā lā tanqaḍī lāstuqillati
